about.title: I'm Gerben Ceuppens
about.p1: Computer science engineer (Ghent University), specialised in artificial intelligence. By day I work as an AI Engineer at Growing pAI. With GinfinAI I put that experience to work for local businesses: a website that brings in customers, or an AI application that saves you hours every week.
about.p2: One point of contact, clear agreements, and code that you own afterwards.
about.bern: Gerben comes from ger (spear) and bern (bear). That's why my AI assistant is called Bern.
